correctness.rationale: Uniform decomposition into two 3-factor joins and 3q^2 antipodal bridges; the geometric cyclic quotient of one parity join has q vertices, q^2 edges and (q^3+2q)/3 cells. Constant-triple cells attach along e_aa once, others along e_ab e_bc e_ca. The resulting pi1 is trivial via explicit relations. Euler and simply connected two-dimensional CW Whitehead argument prove Y is a wedge of ((q-1)^3+2(q-1))/3 two-spheres. The bridge-edge orbits are q(q-1)/2 ordinary edges and q collapsible leaves. All q≥1 including q=1 hold. Independent enumeration of barycentric quotient chains q=1..4 matches ranks in characteristics 2,3,5,7; SNF q=1,2 and boundary square verified. No finite computation asserted to establish infinite result.

value.rationale: The six-cycle is the first cyclic base with distinct antipodal and parity-triple independent sets. The result is an exact infinite family of nonfree geometric rotation quotients up to integral homotopy, revealing a free fundamental group, absence of torsion and positive H2. Stabilizer-aware monochromatic triangle attaching degrees are essential and are not implied by the known equivariant rational homology character formula; the invariant has natural topological significance beyond another parameter substitution.
